title: Cubic vertices in minimal braces
summary: Braces play a fundamental role in matching theory, as they, together with bricks, constitute the basic building blocks of matching covered graphs in the tight cut decomposition. A brace is minimal if deleting any edge from it results in a graph that is not a brace. We prove that every perfect matching of a minimal brace of order at least six contains an edge whose ends both have degree three.
